name: test_curvature.py
mathematical_scope: Projective Fourier-equivalence regressions: necessary cross-ratio/histogram rejection, full monomial gate and recovered coefficient reconstruction.
input_and_guard_coverage: Uses fixed seeds and selected powers of two. Good adversaries include doubled frequencies, arbitrary root-valued entries and a zero entry; no ragged, empty, wrong-size or noncanonical field matrices.
costs: Large oracle probes up to n=4096, and dense full-equivalence checks only through n=64; no all-N speed proof.
test_evidence: Explicit per-entry reconstructed-factor equality L50–54 is strong positive validation. Positive necessary filters merely test non-exclusion, not acceptance sufficiency.
acceptance_boundary: Only full reconstructed monomial equivalence within the exact field can support an equivalence claim; necessary-filter survival does not.
findings: L8–34 intentionally use excluded=False for positive filters. L65–76 protect several otherwise tempting false-sufficiency inferences.
